title: Anthropic Files Confidentially for IPO Following Record Series H
summary: Anthropic has filed confidentially for a landmark IPO after closing a historic $65 billion Series H round, valuing the AI startup at $965 billion.

title: Steven Spielberg's Sci-Fi Thriller 'Disclosure Day' Premieres in Paris
summary: Starring Emily Blunt and Colin Firth, the alien conspiracy film held its Paris premiere ahead of its wide theatrical release on June 12, 2026.

title: Thailand's KMITL Students Win First Prize at Huawei ICT Global Final
summary: Team 'SIGKILL' from KMITL won First Prize in the Computing Track at the Huawei ICT Global Final in Shenzhen, competing against 177 teams globally.

title: Dart 3.12 and Flutter 3.44 Focus on Developer Productivity and AI
summary: Dart 3.12 introduces private named parameters and experimental primary constructors alongside Flutter 3.44's new AI-ready GenUI framework.

title: Isabel J. Kim Releases Highly Anticipated Debut Sci-Fi Novel 'Sublimation'
summary: Astounding Award winner Isabel J. Kim releases her debut novel 'Sublimation', exploring memory, identity, and diaspora in a near-future setting.

title: Flutter 3.44 Released with Agentic Hot Reload & GenUI
summary: Google releases Flutter 3.44 at Google I/O 2026, introducing Agentic Hot Reload for AI assistants and a new Generative UI framework for dynamic layout adapters.

title: Apple TV+ Premieres Spinoff 'Star City'
summary: The highly anticipated 'For All Mankind' spinoff 'Star City' premieres to critical acclaim, detailing the alternate-history space race from the Soviet space program's perspective.

title: Genkit for Dart Introduced
summary: Firebase announces Genkit Dart, letting developers build AI-powered agentic apps in Dart with support for Gemini, Anthropic, and OpenAI.
